newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending flat trend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending flat trend.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to stay virtually flat in thin turnover for the third session running as large undergoing and forthcoming primary market offers draw investor attention from the bourse.
Analysts said the bourse was likely to suffer from the current Bank Handlowy offer on the primary market and copper concern KGHM Polska Miedz public offer which starts on June 30.
But they said recent falls of certain stocks made their prices attractive, which should prevent falls of the overall exchange.
Analysts said Warta, which unexpectedly fell 10 percent fall on Tuesday, was likely to rebound.
